verdict.rationale: Dagster is a data orchestration platform, so whether loaded data lands as typed, deduplicated tables is a fair question. The evidence never shows Dagster itself producing such tables. It shows orchestration of third-party loaders (Fivetran, Airbyte, dlt) and asset checks that verify a schema. Those belong to other products or are adjacent validation controls, not Dagster's own typed, deduplicated loading.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, loaded data lands as typed, deduplicated destination tables ready to query, not raw JSON blobs
